title: Reconcile orphaned merged router PRs into Review
description:
## Problem

A real router task (`kbs-683397b0-e23e-46d3-ae9b-01ab9d687833`) has a merged router-created PR (#294), but lacks durable conversation state because it predates conversation capture. `kbs router recover` reports no recoverable run; `kbs router plan` then offers it again, and `kbs router run --once` exits without a visible issue transition or diagnostic.

## Required behavior

Before scheduling an Open routed issue, reconcile any router-named draft or merged PR for that issue. A merged PR must be surfaced on the issue with its branch and PR evidence and moved to the configured Review state. It must never be dispatched again. If reconciliation cannot determine a safe state, add an exact visible system diagnostic and move the issue to Blocked.

## Acceptance criteria

- Python and Rust planner/executor parity recognizes an orphaned merged `codex/router/<issue>/rN` PR.
- The issue moves to Review, preserves PR/branch evidence, and is absent from future eligible plans.
- An ambiguous or unreachable forge result produces a visible Blocked diagnostic; no silent exit.
- Tests cover the actual `kbs-683397` recovery shape using a fake forge and no MQTT dependency.
- Do not automatically close any issue.
